title: Unified Context Evolution for LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2606.02304v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: LLM-based agents can solve multi-step interactive tasks by combining reasoning with environment feedback, yet each episode starts from the same fixed context and any useful strategy discovered along the way is lost once the task ends. Existing approaches either limit learning to the current task or pool all experience into a single untyped store, without distinguishing knowledge types, tracking quality through use, or balancing what the library still lacks. We introduce Unified Context Evolution (UCE), a gradient-free framework that externalizes agent experience into an evolving library of typed Evolvable Context Units (ECUs). UCE decomposes experience into four complementary types (Memory, Strategy, Workflow, and Skill), each generated from trajectories under type-specific conditions, retrieved at decision time, scored through repeated usage outcomes, and pruned when no longer valuable. translated_title: 面向大语言模型智能体的统一上下文演化
translated_abstract: 基于大语言模型的智能体可以通过将推理与环境反馈相结合来解决多步交互任务，然而每一轮任务都从相同的固定上下文开始，任务过程中发现的任何有用策略在任务结束后都会丢失。现有方法要么将学习限制在当前任务范围内，要么将所有经验汇集到一个单一的无类型存储库中，既没有区分知识类型，也没有在使用过程中追踪质量，更无法平衡知识库中仍然缺失的内容。我们提出了统一上下文演化（UCE），这是一个无需梯度训练的框架，它将智能体经验外化为一个不断演化的、具有类型标签的可演化上下文单元（ECU）库。UCE 将经验分解为四种互补类型（记忆、策略、工作流和技能），每种类型在类型特定条件下从轨迹中生成，在决策时被检索，通过反复使用的结果进行评分，并在不再有价值时被修剪。一个调度模块为每个周期的生成……（原文摘要到此截断）
tldr: 提出了统一上下文演化（UCE）框架，无需梯度训练即可将智能体经验分解为记忆、策略、工作流和技能四种类型的可演化上下文单元（ECU），通过生成、检索、使用评分与修剪机制构建跨任务持续演化的经验库，解决了智能体每轮任务从固定上下文重启、有用策略随任务结束而丢失的问题。
en_tdlr: Unified Context Evolution (UCE) is a gradient-free framework that externalizes agent experience into an evolving library of typed Evolvable Context Units—Memory, Strategy, Workflow, and Skill—which are generated from trajectories, retrieved at decision time, scored through usage outcomes, and pruned when obsolete, enabling LLM agents to accumulate and reuse useful strategies across tasks instead of resetting to a fixed context each episode.
